items.en: «Northrop Grumman Targets 50mm Raid Hunter Drone-Killer Prototype by Mid-2027 After $100M+ Investment, 5km Range Outguns Skynex» (Source: same title)
items.nl: Northrop Grumman mikt op prototype van 50mm-antidronekanon Raid Hunter medio 2027
items.sEn: Defense Express (Borys Gulkevych), drawing on a Janes report from the AUSA 2026 conference, writes that Northrop Grumman aims to have a production-level prototype of its 50mm gun-based air-defence system (50mm GBAD, marketed as Raid Hunter) ready by the end of Q2 2027, intended against drones such as Shahed/Geran.
